abilities.description: After assigning all your stats, add +1 to Edge. Whenever you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ed490d43a2533506]{Set a Course} or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.3ff03b51f620ab26]{Undertake an Expedition}, add +1. Also, whenever you are piloting a ship against an enemy, or through difficult terrain, add +1. You may also start with either the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.62c8297fab069013]{Explorer} asset or the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.4692e18baff8bd18]{Navigator} asset for free (you still get your usual starting assets).

Keen explorer: Whenever you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.367804b98f30d5f4]{Explore a Waypoint}, and score a strong hit with a match, you may either @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.703964b8d02355b8]{Resupply} or downgrade your expedition (to a minimum of Troublesome), and if you roll a miss to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.edac426b7c23f060]{Finish an Expedition}, you may reroll once.
